description: This file defines types, constants, and function prototypes for converting between UTF-8, UTF-16, and UTF-32 encodings, including functions for conversion and validation of UTF sequences.

methods.name: ConvertUTF8toUTF16
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 encoded text to UTF-16 encoding, updating source and target pointers, with error handling based on flags.

methods.name: ConvertUTF16toUTF8
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 encoded text to UTF-8 encoding, updating source and target pointers, with error handling based on flags.

methods.name: ConvertUTF8toUTF32
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 encoded text to UTF-32 encoding, updating source and target pointers, with error handling based on flags.

methods.name: ConvertUTF32toUTF8
methods.description: Converts UTF-32 encoded text to UTF-8 encoding, updating source and target pointers, with error handling based on flags.

methods.name: ConvertUTF16toUTF32
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 encoded text to UTF-32 encoding, updating source and target pointers, with error handling based on flags.

methods.name: ConvertUTF32toUTF16
methods.description: Converts UTF-32 encoded text to UTF-16 encoding, updating source and target pointers, with error handling based on flags.

methods.name: isLegalUTF8Sequence
methods.description: Checks if a sequence of bytes is a legal UTF-8 sequence.
